entrypoint: openswe/threads/router.py -> Managed Deep Agents project mda/agent.py
effects: Managed Deep Agents owns model loop, tools, checkpoints and sandbox. Backend uses PostgreSQL and GitHub credentials; remote sandbox shell/files and publication need execution-host instrumentation. Preserve upstream middleware and sandbox.
next_action: Provision dedicated GitHub App/repository, PostgreSQL and MDA runtime credentials; instrument sandbox execution host. Local minimal executor cannot support shell descendants.
